name: scottievince
caption:
YEAR 6 🎮🏀 Vince Carter was the face of our franchise. In year six, Scottie Barnes is outscoring him.

• Vince, year 6 (2003-04): 22.5 PPG, 4.8 RPG, 4.8 APG, 38.3% from three
• Scottie, year 6, first 8 games: 23.5 PPG, 7.6 RPG, 5.1 APG
• Scottie from three so far: 15.4%
• Vince was traded to New Jersey in December 2004, his seventh season

Year-six Vince or year-six Scottie? 👇

beats.name: SCOTTIE

beats.head: THE CATCH
beats.name: SCOTTIE
beats.vo: The catch? Scottie is hitting fifteen percent from three. Vince could fly and shoot.

facts.claim: Carter, drafted in 1998, played for Toronto 1998-2004: 2003-04 was his 6th season with Toronto; on December 17, 2004 (his 7th season) he was traded to the New Jersey Nets
Barnes drafted 2021 by Toronto; 2026-27 is his 6th NBA season, all with Toronto
